review_scope: AI visual inspection of every assigned final-v3 rendered page 1-26 at 918 x 1188 pixels using image views. Checked margins, clipping, overlap, table row and caption continuity, figure-caption correspondence, labels, fonts and equation rendering. Hash checks bind these images to the current document QA record. This is not human peer review, an independent revalidation of every scientific claim, or coverage of pages 27-52. Superseded v1/v2 inspections are excluded from final coverage.
